rule dac_az_0011 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "Azure: Disk or snapshot export/grant to external tenant - snapshots/beginGetAccess / diskAccess"
    severity = "High"
    rule_id = "DAC-AZ-0011"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1537"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_ACTIVITY"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft.Compute/snapshots/beginGetAccess/action" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft.Compute/disks/beginGetAccess/action" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft.Compute/snapshots/write" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
